```{=html}
<iframe id="dashboard-frame"
  src="food-systems/dashboard/story.html"
  title="Dashboard Sistemas Alimentarios en México"
  loading="eager"
  scrolling="no">
</iframe>

<script>
(function() {
  var frame = document.getElementById('dashboard-frame');
  function resize() {
    try {
      var h = frame.contentDocument.documentElement.scrollHeight;
      if (h > 200) frame.style.height = h + 'px';
    } catch(e) {}
  }
  frame.addEventListener('load', function() {
    resize();
    // Poll while Observable loads data async
    var checks = [300, 600, 1200, 2500, 5000];
    checks.forEach(function(t) { setTimeout(resize, t); });
  });
})();
</script>
```
